propositions: Blocking LINK events written before the comparability structural rule was enacted remain durably wrong on disk, distorting ready/next-batch queries and parent-first cascades because nothing re-resolves them on read.

The doctor scan must enumerate all net-active blocking edges, classify each against the current resolver rule into ancestor-blocking, mis-escalated, or unreadable findings, and repair only those safe to rewrite.

Repair must write the replacement link before removing the stale edge so an interruption leaves a superset the next run converges, and must decline pairs where an unlink would cancel a different relation.
The command must not hold the store write lock across the repair loop to avoid self-deadlock, and must refuse to run while a reconciler pass is in flight.
Read-only runs must not trigger store reconvergence and must initialize with init_only=True; --repair passes use init_only=False.
On the repository's live tracker, 12 edges were repaired (all 9 ancestor-blocking and 3 mis-escalated) and 8 residuals remain inert because their blocked endpoints are closed.
